thread:
tess: Quick check-in on the cohesion-driven carveouts roadmap. We want low-risk, high-value wins to start. Thoughts?

omar: Success metrics first: no user-visible errors, <10% p95 latency regression on carved path, and deployable within a sprint.

li: Acceptance checklist: 1) contract tests in CI, 2) runbook with rollback steps, 3) observability hooks + migration-phase tag, 4) per-tenant kill switch.

pat: DB problem callout: some capabilities read across 3 tables. Two options: event-sourced read side OR shadow-read copies. Event sourcing requires more infra but avoids dual-write.

omar: For fast wins prefer read-side replication for now. We'll plan an event-sourcing follow-up for heavy-write surfaces.

tess: Agree. Prioritize surfaces with single-table read & clear HTTP contract: enricher, idempotent session-touch, reranker. These minimize cross-service consistency complexity.

li: Observability specifics: emit span tag "carveout.id" and "carveout.phase". Instrument KV and DB latencies separately. Add synthetic traffic checks for top 10 tenants during canary.

pat: Rollback policy proposal: immediate fallback to monolith for 5 minutes if error-rate >0.2% OR p95 > baseline*1.25. How long to keep compat shim after full cutover?

omar: Keep compat shim for 7 days read-only, 21 days if writes switched. Advertise in changelog and notify SDK owners.

li: Contract runner stub (to add to CI):
```json
{
  "name": "contract-runner",
  "checks": ["shape", "status_codes", "side_effect_smoke"],
  "timeout_ms": 2000
}
```

tess: Nice. Also include a lightweight load test: 2 minute p95 smoke at 2x typical QPS for a tenant.

pat: Per-tenant throttles: when carving, apply a 10% rate-penalty to noisy tenants unless whitelisted. Also provide a tenant-level kill-switch via router flag.

infra-bot: pipeline:carveout-stub triggered by tess - status: queued.

omar: Data migration sequence idea: frozen snapshot -> backfill into replica -> CDC tail -> validation window with diff queries -> flip reads -> flip writes. Validation queries must be automatable.

li: I'll draft validation SQLs and diff heuristics; suggestion: use hash-of-rows + record-counts per shard to speed checks.

pat: For tech-debt paydown, capture every carveout as 3 tickets: extract service, infra (replication/CDC), and cleanup (deprecate shim). Estimate cleanup cost as part of PR.

tess: Guardrails: max 2 active carveouts, each must have owner + infra shadow on pager for 48h post-100% cutover.

omar: Prioritization: rank by cohesion score (low external calls) and state size. I'll publish a ranked table tomorrow.

li: Action items: li -> validation SQLs + trace tag list (EOD Thu); pat -> replication playbook + approximate infra cost (EOW); tess -> carveout prioritization doc + owners (Mon); omar -> add contract-runner job to CI (PR by Fri).

pat: Few edge notes: ensure idempotency tokens for write cutovers and document compensation flows for billing.

infra-bot: reminder: please attach runbook to the PR for automation on rollback.

li: Ack. I'll include a rollback checklist and example router fallback snippet: 
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/rerank",
  "timeout_ms": 300,
  "fallback": "monolith-rerank",
  "canary_rate": 0.01,
  "tenant_killswitch_header": "X-Tenant-Carveout-Disable"
}
```

tess: Good. No objections from me. We'll treat this as kickoff for the prioritized list once Omar posts it. Short sync next Tue to review owners.

omar: Will do. Thanks all.
